descripcion: Judges whether the interviewee answers what was asked or goes off on a tangent. One exchange per call.

arranca_contestando.instructions: Read the interviewer's question and the start of the person's answer. Decide whether the person's first sentences answer what the interviewer asked.

criteria.true: Yes: they answer what was asked right away (for example, asked where they look, they start by naming where they look).
criteria.false: No: they start talking about something else, a topic they care about, or take a while to get to what was asked.

se_va_a_otro_tema.instructions: Read the interviewer's question and the person's whole answer. Decide whether most of the answer is about something other than what was asked: a topic of their own, an anecdote beside the point, an opinion about something else.

criteria.true: Yes: even if it touches the question at the start, most of it goes to another topic that is not what was asked.
criteria.false: No: most of the answer stays on what was asked, even if it is long or detailed.
